sloka: आजहार ततः खड्गमदूरपरिवर्तिनम्।राक्षसश्चर्मणा सार्धं महावेगो महोदरः ।। ६.९८.२९ ।।
transliteration: ājahāra tataḥ khaḍgamadūraparivartinam।rākṣasaścarmaṇā sārdhaṁ mahāvego mahodaraḥ ।। 6.98.29 ।।

translations.english: Then both of them again and again striking each other slapping with palms fell down and rolled on the ground.
